source: Synthetic ELISA-style binding OD450 for a reference and a test antibody, three independent plates; seed 20260925; not measured biology. Equivalence margins and acceptance limits below are illustrative, not historical.

assay.rationale: Generated from parallel symmetric 4PL curves with proportional noise; demonstrates relative weighting, replicate summary and relative potency.

equivalence.rationale: Illustrative margins for a synthetic demonstration; real margins must come from historical reference-vs-reference assay data

comparison_settings.rp_acceptance_rationale: Illustrative lot-comparison limits; the synthetic test antibody has true RP 2, so failure is expected
